positive_history: original reference path, first-visit observations; final first-visit node must equal its own original goal
negative_history: original path followed by deterministic shortest goal-to-q route; q is not on original path; first-visit observations only
q_selection: first feasible q by ascending SHA256([generation_seed,scan,path_id,q]); path_id is the original normalized string; do not consult the paired goal
shortest_path_rule: D3 shortest_distances: heap(distance,node_id); neighbors in lexicographic node_id order; replace parent only for strictly smaller distance; equal-distance parent is retained
discovered_map_rule: D3 reachability: a new target may be reached only through previously observed intermediate nodes; simulator shortest-route tie and angle parity remain unverified

common_pool.on_shortfall: coverage_pass=false; preserve complete audit and available selection; no automatic downsizing or collection

output: Immutable source/spec/code hashes, all original-path and candidate filtering counts, complete control histories, pair eligibility audit, and fixed common-pool manifest. No method or navigation result.
